name: Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service
benefit: A one-time ex-gratia payment of ₹1,00,000/- shall be made from the UPNL fund to the family/legal dependents of a UPNL employee in the event of the employee’s death during the service period.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a legal dependent of the deceased UPNL employee. 1. The deceased employee must have been a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have been nominated during the service period of the deceased employee to receive the ex-gratia amount.
